schema.name: plan_delivery
schema.description: Plan the stops of a delivery route. Give either `driver.email` or `driver.phone`, but not both and not neither. Adding up `parcels` over every entry of `stops` must give `load_total`. `window_end` must exceed `window_start` in all entries of `stops`.

ship_date.description: Day on which the goods leave the depot.

language.description: Language of the confirmation, as a two-letter ISO 639-1 code.

parcels.description: Number of parcels for the stop.

window_start.description: Hour at which delivery may start.

window_end.description: Hour by which delivery must be done.

load_total.description: Total number of parcels of all stops.
